UserPreferences.title: UserPreferences
UserPreferences.description: Per-user glassmorphic UI customization, theme, icon pack, parallax, and weather city preferences.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this preference document.

blurIntensity.description: Adjustable glass blur intensity percentage from 0 to 100.

iconPack.description: Selected custom vector icon pack style.

parallaxEnabled.description: Whether 3D gyroscope/touch parallax effect is active on clock and cards.

city.description: Selected city name for live weather forecast widget.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last preference update via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

GlassTask.title: GlassTask
GlassTask.description: A user-authored task item with drag-and-drop sort order, category, priority, and smart reminder settings.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID owning this task.

notes.description: Task details or notes (0 to 500 characters).

sortOrder.description: Zero-indexed integer sort order for smooth drag-and-drop task management.

reminderLabel.description: Formatted smart reminder label or schedule.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether smart reminder alert is active for this task.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores per-user glass UI preferences and dashboard configuration.

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: Stores user-owned tasks ordered for drag-and-drop management and smart reminders.
